one_sentence_story: Small worries feel huge at 3 AM because your body clock powers down the rational brake behind your forehead at night while leaving your deep fear alarm running hot.
so_what_for_you: Never solve life problems or send messages between midnight and 6 AM: jot a three-word reminder on paper and let your daytime brain handle it after sunrise.
